content: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (AA): pointer targets need a 24x24 CSS px square inside them, with exceptions incl. spacing (24px circles around undersized targets must not intersect other targets; 20px buttons need 4px gap), equivalent, inline, user-agent-control, essential. AAA 2.5.5 is 44px; iOS HIG uses 44pt, Material 48dp (not cited in W3C doc). MDN overscroll-behavior: contain stops scroll chaining and disables pull-to-refresh/swipe navigation inside that scroll container, none also kills bounce; iOS Safari only gained support in 16; an overflow:hidden container counts as always-at-boundary so contain prevents background scroll behind sheets/dialogs.
